We’ve seen how the Democrats play. They are shady and hate our conservative movement.

**Right now, they are lining up donors to deliver an UPSET in Florida, and that starts with Senator Rick Scott.**

Rick is everything that the swamp establishment and woke Left hate. He tells it like it is, he unapologetically defends President Trump, and he’s willing to take on the radical liberals.

He’s exactly the kind of man the radical Left fears - an unapologetic conservative.

Rick Scott is up for re-election, and this seat is an absolute must-win if we’re going to have any chance at taking back the Senate from Chuck Schumer.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

On the eve of the Cook County Republican Central Committee Convention – Dr. Eric Wallace, who just recently announced his intention to challenge incumbent Sean Morrison for Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party – continues to build momentum across the Chicagoland area after securing the endorsement (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-chicago-cubs-co-owner-former-trump-rnc-finance-chair-todd-ricketts-endorses-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) of Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts late Monday evening.

In a statement issued exclusively to Illinois Review late Tuesday afternoon, Ricketts wrote,
STATEMENT FROM TODD RICKETTS:
“I have known Eric for years and think very highly of him. Illinois Republicans should be excited he is getting more involved, and he will be an asset to the party. That is why I am endorsing him for Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party.”

CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In 2019, President Donald Trump selected Ricketts to serve as Finance Chairman for Trump Victory. Ricketts was also listed as a co-chair for the Palm Beach fundraiser a few weeks ago that raised a record $50.5 million (https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trumps-palm-beach-fundraiser-joined-melania-trump-rakes/story?id=108949489&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for President Trump’s presidential campaign.

Ricketts’ endorsement of Wallace sent shockwaves throughout Illinois on Tuesday – a move that has caught establishment Republicans by surprise. Illinois Republican Party officials, including Morrison, have come under fire for their lack of support for the conservative grassroots base of the party – and for their lack of support for President Trump – the presumptive Republican nominee for President of the United States.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Wallace is widely respected amongst conservatives, and if elected, he’d be the first African American to serve as Chairman of the Cook County Republican Party. Dr. Wallace holds post-graduate degrees in Biblical Studies. A former pastor, Wallace is known as a dynamic speaker and writer and he’s traveled the country talking about faith and public policy. In 2011, Wallace and his wife, Jennifer, founded Freedom’s Journal Institute (FJI) for the Study of Faith and Public Policy, an Illinois-based nonprofit organization designed to “advance the Kingdom of God through socio-political, education and engagement.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/ir-exclusive-cubs-co-owner-todd-ricketts-issues-statement-endorsing-dr-eric-wallace-for-cook-county-gop-chairman-calling-him-an-asset-to-the-party.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37ddee85ee-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Following Ricketts’ endorsement, Elk Grove Township Republican Chairman and Committeeman Ed Lapinski withdrew his name from the race for chairman – writing in an email late Tuesday,

“Hello my fellow Americans,

Please let this email serve as my withdrawal of candidacy for the County Chair position. I am 110% behind Dr. Eric Wallace and urge anyone who would have voted for me to join in support of him as well.”

Lapinski then ended his email with,

“#MakeIllinoisGreatAgain.”

In addition to earning Ricketts’ support, Wallace is also endorsed by former Republican candidate for governor Max Solomon, 18th Ward Committeeman and Chairman of the Southside GOP Devin Jones and New Trier Township Committeeman Julie Cho.

The Cook County Republican Central Committee Convention is April 17th.

clean_body: Everything we do right now makes an impact. | | Derek, As the DNC’s Grassroots Fundraising Director, I spend a lot of time looking at how money comes in. So, after several election cycles at the DNC watching the same pattern play out, I’m very familiar with the “good, better, best” scenario showing the impact of a contribution from a supporter like you. Here's what I mean: When you donate a few days or a few weeks before Election Day, that’s good! We’re able to put last-minute contributions to work in expanding our voter outreach efforts in the final stretch before Election Day. But to be completely honest with you, every time I see those contributions come in, it always leaves me wondering, “How much more could we have done with that donation if we got it a few months ago?" That’s because contributions made with months to go until Election Day are even better. They help fund the early organizing, voter protection and state party programs -- laying a really important foundation for Democrats to ultimately win. Early investments in our work make all the difference. In 2020, Joe Biden won by just a 45,000-vote margin across just three states. Think about that for a second, Derek. That means everything we did in 2020 had a major impact. Every voter we reached, everything we did to protect the right to vote -- all of those efforts made a difference in a race that close. This year, we have to be prepared for the same razor-thin margin. With that in mind, everything we do right now makes an impact. In these months before Election Day, we need to get in touch with as many voters as possible, make sure Democrats’ message is resonating with people all over the country, ensure that our state parties have the infrastructure they’ll need to scale up their work as Election Day draws closer, and that our voter protection programs are strong long before folks cast ballots. By pitching in now, you’ll make all of this work possible, and you’ll help make sure Democrats are in the strongest possible position as November draws closer and closer. Your support means so much. name: Lauren Underwood
subject: This week is so important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Dear friend,

As we observe Black Maternal Health Week, I want to take a moment to talk about this critical issue and why this week is so important to me.

Despite global reductions in maternal mortality rates, preventable deaths related to pregnancy have been rising in the United States over the past two decades.

This rise is driven by far higher mortality rates among Black mothers — who are three to four times more likely to die of pregnancy-related causes.

The impact isn't limited to mothers we’ve lost. Communities of color face a disproportionate burden, with 70 women experiencing "near misses" or lasting health issues for every mother tragically lost. _This is heartbreaking and unacceptable. There's no excuse, we can and must do better._

**That’s why I’m working to pass my Black Maternal Health Momnibus Act — thirteen pieces of legislation that provide the comprehensive resources we need to study and address disparities in access to prenatal care, supportive services, education, and more.**

[**Will you join me and the Voter Protection Project and split a donation to support our work to end our nation’s maternal health crisis? Your partnership means the world to us, and we are grateful to have you by our side.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65837?t=6&akid=13799%2E878179%2ESXfZz3) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Lauren Underwood and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65838?t=7&akid=13799%2E878179%2ESXfZz3)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65842?t=11&akid=13799%2E878179%2ESXfZz3)
Thanks to the hard work of many of my House colleagues on both sides of the aisle, the _Protecting Moms Who Served Act_ was signed into law. This is a major victory for moms everywhere. But our work doesn't stop there. We're looking ahead to pass the next bill, the _Maternal Health for Veterans Act._

As co-founder of the Black Maternal Health Caucus, I'm thrilled to share that we secured significant investments in this year’s federal funding bill to support mothers and address the national crisis. These funds will have a real impact, saving lives and making childbirth safer for countless families.

We're making great strides, but our work isn't finished! Moms across America need the Momnibus now. They can't wait any longer.

[**Momentum is on our side, and now it’s time to keep pushing forward. So in honor of Black Maternal Health Week, will you join me and the Voter Protection Project and split a donation before it ends on April 17? Every dollar is an investment in the health and well-being of mothers and families across America.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65837?t=12&akid=13799%2E878179%2ESXfZz3)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Lauren Underwood and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65838?t=13&akid=13799%2E878179%2ESXfZz3)

As a registered nurse, this issue is deeply personal to me. I’ll never stop working to address this crisis with the urgency it deserves.

Thanks for supporting us on this.

Lauren

## Why Do Bad Things Happen To God's People?
---
Many people ask the question: "why do **bad things** happen to **good people**?" That question is _invalid though_ because the Bible says there is none righteous. Which means there are no good people for bad things to happen to... A better question but much tougher question is this: **WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOD'S PEOPLE?** So many times in life we find ourselves following God yet simultaneously walking through hell. How does that work and why? This last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=9127310.4024.1.610108502f1d79086e51953ed1519083), we addressed this difficult question that we all face. Watch it here: [WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOD'S PEOPLE?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=9127310.4025.1.ebfd60612c86a631ae291c86966e4f6b) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

subject: Sign the petition to ban transgender child mutilation
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=6zs1j7skt6bmn2rn8d8b25iieu8g5zi50di8ew26y2zft4m0mz0hdyzhdcp6n4nxhj8p8341r5hsamc21rvrn84404785g8msi622riwfkvlc6lvt1&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor

* * *

|

Dear Concerned American,

Should so-called doctors be allowed to sexually mutilate or chemically sterilize children – even children as young as 8 years for girls and 10 years for boys?

Should publicly-funded schools be permitted to promote this radical trans-sexual abuse often behind the backs of parents?

I hope you say ABSOLUTELY NOT!

Yet it is happening every day in America. In fact, an insider report from a horrified worker at a Missouri Children's Hospital revealed that the number of children sent for "gender transition" has increased by more than 400% in the last five years.

**That's why I'm emailing you today asking you to sign your petition to your U.S. Representative and Senators demanding they take immediate action to ban the transgender child sexual mutilation and chemical castration procedures**.

I am former U.S. Congressman Paul Broun, and I'm more determined than ever to stop the worldwide tide of Leftism I see targeting our children and grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of members and supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT ideology that has swept through our schools, media, and entertainment, mercilessly attacking the relationships between children and their parents and destroying family morality and faith.

Will you join with millions of pro-family Citizens to defend our children from transgender child sexual mutilation?

**[Click here to sign the petition to Congress demanding they ban all gender transition procedures for minors immediately](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463)**!

Puberty blockers, hormone supplements, and drastic sexual organ surgery are all procedures with horrific side effects that children cannot fully grasp. And in a sea of lies and misinformation, few adults understand the true horror.

Make no mistake, the transgender lobby wants them confused and isolated from any dissenting voices. *** _I've seen an entire generation of youth_ come out of their schools confused and assaulted by the transgender ideology attacking gender and their sense of self, persuading them to seek poisonous and severely harmful procedures to change their bodies to "fit in" with the transgender world. *** **I've seen families torn to pieces as the newest generation of children, who are fed radical transgender values with their cereal, clash with bewildered parents over a child's so-called" gender identity."** *** _In a growing number of States_ , children are encouraged to hide their planned mutilations or chemical castrations from their parents by teachers and counselors. *** _Meanwhile, the transgender lobby_ rabidly shuts down or "cancels" any dissenting voices or studies on the harmful effects of child sexual mutilation. *** _They even more rabidly suppress_ any study of the massive number of children who abandon gender transition after the fact...

... and are left with bitter regrets, twisted bodies and awful consequences. _The best way to put a stop to it all is by passing a flat-out Federal ban on administering these procedures to minors_.

Our children, the most vulnerable members of our society, are being conned into irreversible procedures that alter their bodies and lives forever.

This is not a matter of choice or identity – it's a matter of safety and common sense. Minors are not equipped with the life experience or emotional maturity to make such grave, scarring, and often irreversible decisions about their bodies and their futures.

**[Sign your petition today demanding Congress step in and protect our children from transgender mutilation](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463)**.

Over 20 states have already passed bans on transgender child sexual mutilation, though many are being challenged in court.

But states like California and New York will not follow suit willingly, and the transgender lobby is howling for blood at the restrictions being placed on them.

**That's why, once you've signed, I ask you to chip in with a modest contribution to help CitizenGO bring other Americans into the fight against child sexual mutilation. Even a gift of $10 or $25 will be a big boost.**

The success of this campaign relies on the power of Citizens standing together to make our voices heard, and every extra dollar counts when we're fighting to counter the transgender lobby's pervasive ideology.

**[So please, sign your petition, share, and chip in with a quick $10 or $25 contribution to help CitizenGO recruit more signers and win the fight](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463)**.

In addition to recruiting more petition signers to increase the impact of our campaign, your contribution will help fund:
* _Hard-hitting advertisements_ to highlight and draw attention to the horrible practices of transgender centers.
* _Targeted petition deliveries_ to key elected officials demanding they take action to defend children.
* _Phone calls to likely supporters_ to raise awareness and recruit new members.
* _Radio and TV ads_ exposing everything the transgender ideology is inflicting on our children, should funds permit.

So once you have signed, I ask that you make a contribution of $10 or $25 to CitizenGO, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or $100, to help expand their recruitment and to fund all of these plans in CitizenGO's fight to stop child sexual mutilation.

**[So please sign your petition, share, and chip in with a generous contribution of $10 or $25, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or $100 today](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463)**.

Thank you for standing with us in this crucial fight for our children's future.

Sincerely,

Paul C. Broun (MD)
U.S. Congressman Georgia 10 Ret.

P.S. I'm more determined than ever to stop the worldwide tide of Leftism I see targeting our children and grandchildren.

_CitizenGO represents millions of members and supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT ideology, and I want every pro-sanity American to band together to put a stop to child sexual mutilation and chemical castration_.

The best way to do that is with a Federal ban on performing Transgender procedures on minors, and CitizenGO is launching a campaign to do just that. But it will take people power to succeed.

**[That's why I'm counting on you to sign your petition, and then go on to add a modest $10 or $25 contribution, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or $100, to help CitizenGO fight to ban child sexual mutilation](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463)**.

**In addition to signing your petition and donating, I need you to share it with your friends and family who share our values so they can have the opportunity to sign as well. CitizenGO's petition page makes it super easy to share in a way you prefer.**

---
| CitizenGO is a community of active citizens that works to ensure that human life, the family and our freedoms are respected worldwide. CitizenGO members live in every nation of the world. Our team is spread across 16 countries on 5 continents and operates in 12 languages. Learn about CitizenGO [here](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=1krvqwt8yrhg3go3r01kd1x1um8tzfza8t0cc2993iedlnoygyg5d3k0v2rysucxeapjrgr5eczt7q1yqlm0s798ugvddyxwoju1a6qic6bol9bvwwepab3r2hkzm4m5w9jhlyhy6jb8f1lfgpabrtux2&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463) or follow us on [Facebook](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=bqgg4nchnst6up6l831rj7s8zwhxbeheu14ofdkscsfuvkyltyj7d7qys8uahz5t61zwm3x2e8undlgn1ybrmgwkdrrgyzed76gy99zzfkvonhz3pplobcv37txwugrr9cicm6rtu2u0l10&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463) or [Twitter](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=1f7nalmza5xljbdmscyp2ksvsf4c23osjy1ql25h33dkoyaub95rz6qjk3552qxys2oww3gk2l1tcb9m8jier17ponu5llois653yyxq1icuu938i6olllunftvv4tsjqgt4djbx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sc3463).

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

Don’t miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Don’t let them ignore my assault
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsA3QfqiNJ

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osA3QfqiNJ

Fellow Conservative,
At San Francisco State University
last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob,
barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours.
I'm still waiting for justice.
The news just broke that the
investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco
State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who
replied to my inquiry said, "The charges in this case are
unfounded."
This just encourages what
happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question
common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don't see this
happen to so-called "progressive" speakers, or to anyone who
dissents from my viewpoint.
While I was locked in the
classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on
social media, "When they want you silent, speak louder." I am
more determined than ever to keep speaking louder.
That's exactly what my team and I
do here at the Leadership Institute.
Through the Riley Gaines Center
at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I
spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common
sense, and free speech.
We travel the country to spread
the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and
women to share their stories and protect themselves against
radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and
the very concept of truth itself.
Women fought for equality. Now
our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves
women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts
them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to
dissent.

That's why my colleagues and I
show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect
them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they
develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people
become principled leaders on their campuses and in their
communities - and fight for America's future.
I'd love to have you join this
movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.
Stand bravely with me,
Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center
at the Leadership Institute

Train Leaders for
America

The Leadership Institute, 1101 N.
Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201

body:
Tune in
| | | |
VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY RECONVENES
TODAY NOON
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 17

---
---
| Friends, Today is a big day. The Virginia General Assembly returns to Richmond for Reconvene, also called Veto Session beginning at noon. You can watch online from the comfort of your own home by clicking the link below.
Governor Youngkin has set the new record, vetoing more bills in one year than any other Virginia governor, at 153 vetoes out of 1,046 bills.
The Governor has soundly rejected the Democrat's tax and spend agenda that raises taxes on every Virginian. He has offered 242 amendments total to the proposed budget bill, which raised some eyebrows by the Democrat controlled General Assembly. Personally, I think the Governor was generous.
With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
That said, word is that the Democrat controlled legislature plans to take up all of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block and veto them.
I anticipate a stand off that will include a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian.
In summary, Governor Youngkin has offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly and signed 777 bills into law.
Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.
---
|
---
Please also consider following me on [Facebook at Amanda Chase Virginia Senator](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jrHyyEQo6LN-KpYFCLd6eJIPBcQv6opYb9TXwABHBPmLhPC0hHLsgxYkNUBN84yk1EDQceAVR7SXKYJtwjw7u_7CN0GTRU9hX9HMMWxLSBNFoLYIh6iVk175doVPJG6AH3H6k1m-ivr254IwBycb1BFTnrN00nSe0wn586cJk37fcu8AuCkeCZxrx-o2ExytrBpWeCwX2jc=&c=0NGkhugq-DlifLkbJv5B3mDOjhtyhrdSSanFSFz9GdTbE2uYOHpBzw==&ch=RfYNVSw-b4sHMXt2UH_-7vMMCgLCr--ibhfFz646to84_4JLMiYhHQ==) for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills.
Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly.
Hope you will tune in today at noon to watch your General Assembly take up the Governor's amendments.
Will Virginians be taxed more by the Democrat controlled General Assembly or will Governor Youngkin continue to push back and win for Virginians who are taxed enough already?

# Governor's Budget Amendments
---
|
* Governor Youngkin has proposed a grand total of 242 amendments to budget bills HB 29 and HB 30. He wants to "preserve the vast majority of spending priorities as passed by the General Assembly."

* Governor Youngkin supports his $64 billion Common Ground Budget which eliminates all proposed tax increases, invests a record $21.2 billion in K-12 education, caps tuition increases at 3%, includes 3% pay raises for teachers and state employees in each year, and increases investments in health and human resources by $3.2 billion over the biennium.

* The budget passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly eliminated over $850 million of the Governor's priority spending items in the introduced budget and $1 billion of tax relief; the Common Ground budget restores only $230 million of those priorities.

* The Governor's Common Ground budget includes $196 million in additional funding for at-risk students, an additional $1 billion in higher education funding, $175 million for the Housing Trust Fund, toll relief in Hampton Roads, a full funding of the state's share of WMATA's short-term funding needs, and $70 million to expedite projects on Interstate-81.

* Our reserve fund balances are among the best of any state in the nation. We have over $4.6 billion in reserve funds representing 15% of our annual general fund spending. Revenue collections are running ahead of the revenue forecast by $827 million year to date.

* In short, Virginia can fund priorities and maintain our long-term structural balance without raising taxes. The Governor proposed 1 billion in tax relief in his introduced budget, while the budget passed by the General Assembly included tax increases that would cost Virginians $2.6 billion in total. The Governor claims the Common Ground budget allows us to write a clean budget without tax increases or tax decreases.

The Virginia General Assembly returns to Richmond for Reconvene, also called Veto Session beginning at noon. You can watch online from the comfort of your own home by clicking the link below. Governor Youngkin has set the new record, vetoing more bills in one year than any other Virginia governor, at 153 vetoes out of 1,046 bills. The Governor has soundly rejected the Democrat's tax and spend agenda that raises taxes on every Virginian. He has offered 242 amendments total to the proposed budget bill, which raised some eyebrows by the Democrat controlled General Assembly. Personally, I think the Governor was generous. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes. That said, word is that the Democrat controlled legislature plans to take up all of Governor Youngkin's amendments in a block and veto them. I anticipate a stand off that will include a battle over the budget. The Democrat controlled legislature wants to increase taxes on every Virginian. Governor Youngkin is opposing and vetoing legislation that would raise taxes on every Virginian. In summary, Governor Youngkin has offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly and signed 777 bills into law. Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend. Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar. | Please also consider following me on == for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills. Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly. Hope you will tune in today at noon to watch your General Assembly take up the Governor's amendments. Will Virginians be taxed more by the Democrat controlled General Assembly or will Governor Youngkin continue to push back and win for Virginians who are taxed enough already? name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: BLEXIT backs the blue
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs1RYzqiN6

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os1RYzqiN6

Friend,

I am so
grateful for our police officers.

As an
American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I
have always stood with the public servants who protect our
communities.

Please
join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our 'Back
the Blue Petition' and letting brave officers know that we are
grateful for their service and sacrifice.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling
criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to "defund the
police."

I refuse
to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our
society and that the black community must fight and scream and
demand support for the people in our community who are up to no
good.

That's
one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an organization focused on
shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and
uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of
community service.

Around
the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers,
while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve
our communities.

To join
these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the
national petition today.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

This
summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the
Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the
city's police force.

The first
state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina - paid a visit to local
officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you
notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you
'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must support local heroes -
please sign the national petition right away.

While the
'defund the police' crowd wants us to think minorities stand with
them - polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more
than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase.

We've
been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals - those lies have
been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a
whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day.

We must
stop the deception that is harming urban communities and
demeaning police around the nation.

If you
are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want
law and you should want order. That is the way forward.

Join me
in letting our police officers know that you support law and
order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities
safe.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace
Owens
Chair of
BLEXIT
Powered
by Turning Point USA

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td9a614b8-85da-472b-9131-9a3f6acf7308/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7ffa41dc-66fa-461e-82f7-c4f6ee7cb000/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that [in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0bf246e7-02ac-42a2-8dee-7439b4e1e682/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: [Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Blue Amp Action ahead of their deadline at midnight? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbf1b1c68-a956-46f0-bfc6-df0f364608a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. [Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act: Join me in supporting 314 Action and Blue Amp Action. Let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T810a7230-947e-453f-b233-a3c9c6e75ade/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Happy Hump Day! Did you know Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. penned his profound “Letter from a Birmingham Jail” on April 16, 1963? Check out [yesterday's ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[commentary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to learn more. And make sure to check out more commentary by some of Colorado's strongest conservative voices featured below. This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 17, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Do only four frontrunners remain in 4th District race? It appeared that way in Kit Carson County.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
BURLINGTON — A handful of candidates vying to become Eastern Colorado’s next representative to Congress didn’t make one of the state’s bright, bright red counties a destination here Friday for the [Kit Carson County Republican Party’s Lincoln Dinner](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The county situated on the Kansas border has delivered decisive, state-leading vote-count margins for Republican candidates for President, most recently giving Donald Trump 80% of the vote in both 2016 and 2020, supporting Mitt Romney with 75% support and John McCain with 66% respectively in 2012 and 2008, and George W. Bush with 72% support in his first run and 77% in his bid for re-election. In his final election, [Rep. Ken Buck earned 85% of all votes from the county](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). In Burlington on Friday, it [appeared as if only frontrunners remained in the race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), understandable considering recent delegate votes in both the primary and special election races. What had at one point been a double-digit field of candidates in the 4th District featured [three candidates and one candidate’s designee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Kit Carson County, perhaps what ranchers in Eastern Colorado might view as a cull of the herd. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Supreme Court grapples with obstruction charge lobbed at 350 Jan. 6 defendants, Trump**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Supreme Court is grappling with the government's case [against 350 Jan. 6 defendants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from the 2021 Capitol protest.

* Justices are considering how a[ law written in response to the Enron scandal ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)applies to those who halted the 2020 election certification.

* GOP-appointed justices are [challenging the Justice Department's use of the law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), questioning its consistency in similar situations, such as the Portland courthouse riot and Rep. Jamaal Bowman's disruption of a House vote.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Your hard-earned dollars shouldn’t go to Leftist media outlets**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY KATIE PAVLICH, [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Over [$500 million of taxpayer money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is funneled through the Corporation for Public Broadcasting to National Public Radio (NPR) annually.

* NPR, despite claiming to be an [independent news organization](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), has been criticized for its leftist bias and attacks on conservatives. NPR's lack of coverage on significant stories, such as Hunter Biden's laptop, has raised concerns about its [editorial integrity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* The new CEO of NPR, Katherine Maher, holds [extreme leftist views](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and advocates for controversial positions like discouraging childbirth for climate change reasons and supporting looting as reparations. Critics argue that taxpayer dollars should not fund a media outlet that promotes such divisive and radical ideologies.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: The left’s assault on American patriotism**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY MIKE ROSEN, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Wall Street Journal survey in 2023 found a [decline in the importance of patriotism among Americans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with only 38% considering it very important, down from 70% in 1998.

* The decline in patriotic sentiment is attributed to the [influence of the American left](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The emergence of the "New Left" in the 1960s and 70s, influenced by figures like Herbert Marcuse, laid the groundwork for leftist ideologies to [infiltrate educational institutions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and shape generations of students.

* Rosen discusses the left's portrayal of American history as inherently negative and its promotion of guilt and self-loathing, aiming to[ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[dismantle traditional values](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and culture in favor of socialist ideals, as outlined in a strategy proposed by Marxist activists in the 1960s.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Court sends a reminder; tax hikes require voter consent**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY TYLER MARTINEZ, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Court of Appeals [unanimously ruled in favor of taxpayers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) represented by the National Taxpayers Union Foundation’s Taxpayer Defense Center, declaring the doubling of property taxes in some Northern Colorado counties [unconstitutional under the Colorado Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights (TABOR)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* The case involved James Aranci and his neighbors, who challenged the [doubling of property taxes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to the Lower South Platte Water Conservancy District without a TABOR vote, as mandated by law. The court also dismissed the water district's assertion that waiving the right to vote on future tax increases was implied in a 1996 ballot measure, emphasizing that such increases [require prior approval from voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* The ruling [sends the case back to the trial court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for further proceedings on class certification for property owners to receive refunds and attorneys’ fees, marking a significant [victory for taxpayers in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Friend,

I wanted to remind you about two upcoming events.

Tomorrow, April 18 is our Pints & Politics event on St. Croix from 6 to 8 p.m. at Nate's Boathouse on the boardwalk in Christiansted. This is a great opportunity to come together and meet fellow Republicans as well as some of our potential local candidates.

Then on May 3 is the Boot Camp for candidates, candidate campaign team members, Republican State Committee members, and anyone interested in being more politically active. The training is scheduled for 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. with a break for lunch at The Westin, Frenchman's Reef on St. Thomas. For those of you on St. Croix, many of us are flying over on the early-morning Cape Air and Seaborne flights.

I hope to see you at one or both of these events. If you're interested in running for local office or attending either of the events, just reply to this email and I'll do my best to answer any questions you may have.

Valerie Stiles
Chairman, Republican Women's Leadership Committee

# [Join me Tuesday, April 23rd in Atherton!](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=09fb2fba9d&e=c0babbc643)

| [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=bcd0f262f5&e=c0babbc643) **Meet local author Kevin F. Adler in Atherton next Tuesday at 6:30 PM. I'll be there to learn more about him and his book, When We Walk By.**

Think about the last time that you saw or interacted with an unhoused person. What did you do? What did you say? Did you offer money or a smile, or did you avert your gaze?

_When We Walk By_ takes an urgent look at homelessness in America, showing us what we lose—in ourselves and as a society—when we choose to walk past and ignore our neighbors in shelters, insecure housing, or on the streets. And it shows what we stand to gain when we embrace our humanity and move toward evidence-based people-first, community-driven solutions, offering social analysis, economic and political histories, and the real stories of our unhoused neighbors.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: April 17, 2013 was a devastating day
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
On this day eleven years ago, a minority in the Senate used the filibuster to block legislation to expand background checks shortly after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School.
#

Eleven years ago today, a minority in the Senate used the filibuster to block legislation to expand background checks shortly after the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School.
While today we are closer to universal background checks than we’ve ever been, we still have far more work to do to make this a reality.
[**Today, I hope you will take a moment to read my op-ed below from that dark day and make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC. Please, help us continue our work in the fight to end America’s gun violence epidemic.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240417-1-30&t=1&akid=7961%2E3935704%2ER3JtwR)
\- Gabby
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240417-1-30&t=2&akid=7961%2E3935704%2ER3JtwR)**
* * *

SENATORS say they fear the N.R.A. and the gun lobby. But I think that fear must be nothing compared to the fear the first graders in Sandy Hook Elementary School felt as their lives ended in a hail of bullets. The fear that those children who survived the massacre must feel every time they remember their teachers stacking them into closets and bathrooms, whispering that they loved them, so that love would be the last thing the students heard if the gunman found them.
On Wednesday, a minority of senators gave into fear and blocked common-sense legislation that would have made it harder for criminals and people with dangerous mental illnesses to get hold of deadly firearms — a bill that could prevent future tragedies like those in Newtown, Conn., Aurora, Colo., Blacksburg, Va., and too many communities to count.
Some of the senators who voted against the background-check amendments have met with grieving parents whose children were murdered at Sandy Hook, in Newtown. Some of the senators who voted no have also looked into my eyes as I talked about my experience being shot in the head at point-blank range in suburban Tucson two years ago, and expressed sympathy for the 18 other people shot besides me, 6 of whom died. These senators have heard from their constituents — who polls show overwhelmingly favored expanding background checks. And still these senators decided to do nothing. Shame on them.
I watch TV and read the papers like everyone else. We know what we’re going to hear: vague platitudes like “tough vote” and “complicated issue.” I was elected six times to represent southern Arizona, in the State Legislature and then in Congress. I know what a complicated issue is; I know what it feels like to take a tough vote. This was neither. These senators made their decision based on political fear and on cold calculations about the money of special interests like the National Rifle Association, which in the last election cycle spent around $25 million on contributions, lobbying and outside spending.
Speaking is physically difficult for me. But my feelings are clear: I’m furious. I will not rest until we have righted the wrong these senators have done, and until we have changed our laws so we can look parents in the face and say: We are trying to keep your children safe. We cannot allow the status quo — desperately protected by the gun lobby so that they can make more money by spreading fear and misinformation — to go on.
I am asking every reasonable American to help me tell the truth about the cowardice these senators demonstrated. I am asking for mothers to stop these lawmakers at the grocery store and tell them: You’ve lost my vote. I am asking activists to unsubscribe from these senators’ e-mail lists and to stop giving them money. I’m asking citizens to go to their offices and say: You’ve disappointed me, and there will be consequences.
People have told me that I’m courageous, but I have seen greater courage. Gabe Zimmerman, my friend and staff member in whose honor we dedicated a room in the United States Capitol this week, saw me shot in the head and saw the shooter turn his gunfire on others. Gabe ran toward me as I lay bleeding. Toward gunfire. And then the gunman shot him, and then Gabe died. His body lay on the pavement in front of the Safeway for hours.
I have thought a lot about why Gabe ran toward me when he could have run away. Service was part of his life, but it was also his job. The senators who voted against background checks for online and gun-show sales, and those who voted against checks to screen out would-be gun buyers with mental illness, failed to do their job.
They looked at these most benign and practical of solutions, offered by moderates from each party, and then they looked over their shoulder at the powerful, shadowy gun lobby — and brought shame on themselves and our government itself by choosing to do nothing.
They will try to hide their decision behind grand talk, behind willfully false accounts of what the bill might have done — trust me, I know how politicians talk when they want to distract you — but their decision was based on a misplaced sense of self-interest. I say misplaced, because to preserve their dignity and their legacy, they should have heeded the voices of their constituents. They should have honored the legacy of the thousands of victims of gun violence and their families, who have begged for action, not because it would bring their loved ones back, but so that others might be spared their agony.
This defeat is only the latest chapter of what I’ve always known would be a long, hard haul. Our democracy’s history is littered with names we neither remember nor celebrate — people who stood in the way of progress while protecting the powerful. On Wednesday, a number of senators voted to join that list.
Mark my words: if we cannot make our communities safer with the Congress we have now, we will use every means available to make sure we have a different Congress, one that puts communities’ interests ahead of the gun lobby’s. To do nothing while others are in danger is not the American way.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240417-1-30&t=3&akid=7961%2E3935704%2ER3JtwR)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=7961%2E3935704%2ER3JtwR) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

**But this cycle _isn't_ endless. The next mass killing _isn't_ inevitable. There are concrete, straightforward steps that we can take _right now_ to end the cycle and protect our communities from gun violence.** And the vast majority of Americans support these kinds of commonsense reforms.
In 2022, we took a meaningful step forward by passing a package of gun safety reforms — including Kirsten's legislation to end gun trafficking. But there is so much more that we must still do. Kirsten won't stop fighting until we pass this legislation and end this epidemic, but she needs grassroots Americans like you to stand with her.

Friend, I'll never forget what it felt like to finally become an American citizen.
I came to America as a 14-year-old. Moving to a new country and trying to make ends meet wasn't easy. But this country gave my family the chance to dream of a future full of opportunities that we could not have had in Ecuador.
So when I had the chance to become a citizen, I took it. I studied hard to pass the exam, memorizing branches of government, founding fathers, and articles of the Constitution. My naturalization ceremony was held in a huge room with hundreds and hundreds of new Americans. American flags were _everywhere_. I remember proudly singing the national anthem and saying the Pledge of Allegiance as the weight of the moment began to sink in.
If you were born an American, I don't think it's possible to fully understand exactly what becoming a citizen means — the sense of relief after spending so many years fighting for and dreaming of this moment.**Knowing that you've finally made it. This is truly your home now. You're here. You've done it. And more than anything else,_you're safe._**
Your freedoms and rights are guaranteed. Your government will protect you. You have the right to choose your leaders. And you can count on the peaceful transition of power.
**I knew in that moment, as I proudly said the Pledge of Allegiance, that I had a sacred responsibility to protect my new country and make sure that families here could count on this all-too-rare sense of safety for generations to come.** I vowed to vote, to be involved in my community, to give back, and to make a difference however I could.
That journey led me all the way to Congress, where I had the privilege of speaking at naturalization ceremonies like the one I had attended decades ago. But in the years since I became a citizen, I've watched extremists threaten that precious safety. They've spread conspiracies about our elections, blocked commonsense gun safety reforms, and incited a deadly insurrection that ended the peaceful transition of power.
**_That’s why I’m running for Senate. To save the promise of the American Dream — prosperity, freedom, and safety._**
With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable Senators up for reelection this year, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck. **[So please, will you join the fight for a better, safer future by donating $5 to my campaign? and this election is a critical moment for our country.
#
Peter,
In 2016, the last time a Missouri U.S. Senate race and presidential election happened at the same time, more than 200,000 split-ticket voters brought labor-backed veteran Jason Kander just 2.7% away from defeating a GOP incumbent and flipping Missouri’s Senate seat.
Since then, Missourians have voted overwhelmingly to take back their power at the ballot box by raising the minimum wage, expanding healthcare, rejecting an anti-union “Right-to-Work” law, and legalizing weed.
**But this year, we’re facing the most important election of our lifetimes.**
From his actions on January 6 to his repeated attacks on reproductive freedom, Josh Hawley has shown people in Missouri that he is a fraud, a coward, and a threat to our democracy — and they are paying attention.
Republicans and Democrats across Missouri agree that our state — and our country — deserve better than Josh Hawley. Even his own former mentor, three-term GOP U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said that supporting Hawley’s original run for Senate in 2018 was _“the worst decision [he’s] ever made in [his] life.”_
And that’s why this race is now a complete toss-up. **Multiple polls have confirmed that Hawley is neck-and-neck with Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**
This race is absolutely critical — for Missouri, and _for the entire country._

Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. In a world where political noise drowns out the voices of hard working Americans like us, **your attention means everything.**

**Did you know that only a fraction of supporters open these emails, and even fewer take action?** Yet, it's individuals like you and me, who understand the challenges our communities face who hold the power to make a difference.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: The latest attacks from my MAGA opponent
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends, I really, really try not to give my MAGA opponent any more oxygen than his backwards ideas deserve. I mean, this is a guy who regularly goes on OAN and Fox News to praise Donald Trump and spout off the latest absurd and dangerous conspiracy theories the far-right is pushing.
But I do want to take a second to address a recent criticism he made of me – because the reality is, he’ll be on the ballot in November and he’ll be spending as much as he can to turn out his GOP base.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6179797872366C46517043474856717253534458372B654C564B78554861304A7335574F6B377543312B454C67712B414F316C566C71786F554E51524A613237/editor_images/BillWells-FB.png]
“We need serious leaders” ... I can only assume what he actually means is that we need someone who isn’t a young woman – because really, it just doesn’t make sense any other way.
I’m a member of the House Armed Services Committee and House Foreign Affairs Committee, where I’m the Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Africa.
I’m a member of the Bipartisan Task Force on Artificial Intelligence. I’m Vice Chair of the Congressional Equality Caucus, Founding Co-Chair of the Protection of Civilians in Conflict Caucus, and Co-Chair of the Congressional Ghana Caucus.
Oh, and I’m the youngest member of our Democratic House leadership, too.
My background before serving in Congress includes policy work at the United Nations, UNICEF, and the State Department. And I founded two non-profits that are still doing impactful work for our community and the world.
But of course, to some people, you can’t be a young woman – especially one with interests and hobbies – and also be a serious leader! I call BS.
Look – I would love to brush this off and fully ignore every single word that comes out of my opponent’s mouth.
But unfortunately, he’s shown that he can raise enough money from fellow GOP extremists to run a serious campaign against me, and he’s going to spend every penny he can trying to flip our district red.
The rise of candidates like my opponent is directly connected to Donald Trump and his brand of MAGA politics that he’s made popular for so many people on the right – and the fact is, it’s not enough to eke out narrow victories when we’re dealing with this kind of extremism.
We need to deliver resounding Democratic victories this November – in my race and in races all across the country – and make a clear statement that this is not who we are .
To do that, Democrats have to boost our fundraising numbers. Will you help out by making a donation of $25, $50, or even $100 to my re-election campaign today? Your contribution will go directly towards defeating my MAGA opponent. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thanks so much. I really appreciate your support!
-Sara
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District

If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] And if you can’t give at all, I understand. I appreciate you taking the time to read these emails and stay connected with my campaign – regardless of whether or not you’re able to chip in financially. Thank you!

It’s embarrassing. It’s sad. But most of all, it’s dangerous.
#

Kyrsten Sinema is not running for re-election.
Kari Lake is the presumptive nominee of the Republican Party in Arizona’s U.S. Senate race.
Someone who cozies up to the furthest of the far-right: Steve Bannon, Mike Lindell, Mike Flynn, Roger Stone — and of course, Trump himself.
Someone who supports the near total abortion ban in Arizona and who continues to level baseless and unfounded conspiracies at honorable election workers.

subject: The first real threat to Jim Jordan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Team,
As the official Democratic nominee running against Jim Jordan one thing has become abundantly clear: Jim and his radical-right donors are TERRIFIED of the momentum we’re building.
I’m a tenacious fighter with a reputation for speaking my mind - and I won’t shy away from a bruising fight with Jim Jordan—and that’s got his entire team shaking in their boots.
Right now, a lot of my focus is on talking with voters, attending events, and getting my message out to the people. That means I’m relying heavily on grassroots donors like you to help me grow my team, hit our fundraising goals, and flip this seat blue!
We’ve got a huge deadline coming up in just a few days, and, frankly, it’s all hands on deck to hit our goals.
Before I head back out into the field, I have to ask: Will you rush a donation of $25, $50, or whatever you can spare -- split with Serve America -- to help me stand up to Jim Jordan and WIN? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-wilson]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-wilson]
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to take the fight to Jim Jordan and get this seat into Democratic hands.
But in order to get the job done, we have to take these fundraising goals seriously.
Your support means the world to me, and it will help us continue to grow this grassroots campaign that will take down Jim Jordan! What could be better than that?
Click here to rush a contribution! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-wilson]
I’m so grateful for your support,
Tamie

| | Peter, we’ll get straight to the point: Georgia is the key to stopping Donald Trump and continuing our progress.

In 2020, Georgia was critical to defeating Trump, flipping the Senate, and making it possible for Joe Biden to pass transformational laws like the Bipartisan Infrastructure Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, the American Rescue Plan, the first major gun safety legislation in decades, the CHIPs Act, enact student debt relief for hard working Americans, and appoint Ketanji Brown Jackson, the first Black woman on the Supreme Court.

**Now, in 2024, Georgia is yet again the key to our progress._If we win Georgia, Donald Trump has almost NO path to the White House._**

So here’s the path to victory: we need a grassroots movement the likes of which Georgia has never seen. Dear Peter, My name is Hung Cao. **I came to the United States as a refugee from Vietnam, one of the last families to escape the communists in 1975.** I spent my youth in West Africa where my dad found work only to return to the United States at the age of 12 to learn English and attend American schools. I grabbed on the American Dream and was part of the inaugural graduating class of Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and earned Fellowships to MIT and Harvard. **BUT I PAID BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM IN FULL WITH 25 YEARS OF SERVICE IN NAVY SPECIAL OPERATIONS.** I saw combat in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. I dove down to recover John F Kennedy Jr’s plane and recovered victims from the earthquake in Pakistan. Along the way, my wife of 25 years and I created a 501(c)3 non-profit that builds beeping Easter Eggs for visually impaired children, to teach service to our five children. We were featured at the White House Easter Egg Roll several times. In any other instance I would be featured in the front of magazines for running for U.S. Senate against a career, entrenched politician. But there is one problem: **THE “R” BEHIND MY NAME.** Yes, I am the Democrats’ worst nightmare. A LEGAL immigrant who pulled himself up by the bootstraps, who fought and bled for our country and believes that the**United States is the best country in the WORLD!**
---
[**STAND WITH HUNG CAO >>**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=b9e77765a55d464687cef40f13b29c46&_e=ebxVzoe1eV0J29XtC0Wwr8zjVojeJQkvj_n95c9UckJ4seloRH50Ll0zOiAgmNkm3wOFF9La6Ebq4D5WOAr_AqVrxTpH8kBlvJY3_Tsx3Ra2vhGg4AWf-Dw9HxhPRFKTZcy-06D228vugtTjRzf2Xmc7YfC2aFI3Sh2K7tCZZu1mNfmi6rOlvLU3wANfZgzCaL2ZfZK_UOsLjbSf-H1uMvpyiFBOhNTIfCjfsJ6Hv9DMRKnZBQeR2_ja67l0xPAEohIDb7qolnTlBqIU8enoRrZMpAyGr1BHy7iAlhZ3dk2qH-LbgFRKBK-SHOyLsaeUCaAqG-ZeUy3N20CIgv6OZtFWLZHOJdMXTxHmLe6NX_U%3D)

They unleashed the power of the media against me, hiring a Wisconsin reporter to do a hit job on me. They are unencumbered by facts, details or the law, in an attempt to intimidate my donors. In their articles, they call me a failed Congressional candidate, but they never mentioned **that I moved a very blue district in Northern Virginia, which includes Loudoun County, by 13%.** Joe Biden won by 19% in this district and I lost by less than 6%. Do you know who else was a failed Congressional candidate but won his U.S. Senate seat? Barack Obama (not that I want his name on the same line as mine). **My opponent Tim Kaine is scared. He sees that I am very close to unseating him, so he has called me everything from an extremist, to white adjacent, to a NAZI**! I never realized a Vietnamese refugee who fought for our country can be a Nazi, but again, they are unencumbered by facts or details. My wife and I were fully aware of the nasty lies and attacks against our good name and our family. They have even come after my employers to get them to fire me. We prayed a long time about running for office, but we knew if we didn’t step up, who would? **We are answering the call.** We can’t be intimidated by their leftist, Marxist strategies. I have put my life on the line on the battlefield, faced death and looked at pure evil in the eyes. These Democrats don’t scare me one bit, because I have woken up without a flag to stand under or a country to call my own. **I WILL NOT ALLOW THAT TO HAPPEN TO OUR CHILDREN OR GRANDCHILDREN!** Over my dead body! **[**Stand with me! clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, My name is Hung Cao. I came to the United States as a refugee from Vietnam, one of the last families to escape the communists in 1975. I spent my youth in West Africa where my dad found work only to return to the United States at the age of 12 to learn English and attend American schools. I grabbed on the American Dream and was part of the inaugural graduating class of Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and earned Fellowships to MIT and Harvard. BUT I PAID BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM IN FULL WITH 25 YEARS OF SERVICE IN NAVY SPECIAL OPERATIONS. I saw combat in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. I dove down to recover John F Kennedy Jr’s plane and recovered victims from the earthquake in Pakistan. Along the way, my wife of 25 years and I created a 501(c)3 non-profit that builds beeping Easter Eggs for visually impaired children, to teach service to our five children. We were featured at the White House Easter Egg Roll several times. In any other instance I would be featured in the front of magazines for running for U.S. Senate against a career, entrenched politician. But there is one problem: THE “R” BEHIND MY NAME. Yes, I am the Democrats’ worst nightmare. A LEGAL immigrant who pulled himself up by the bootstraps, who fought and bled for our country and believes that theUnited States is the best country in the WORLD! They unleashed the power of the media against me, hiring a Wisconsin reporter to do a hit job on me. They are unencumbered by facts, details or the law, in an attempt to intimidate my donors. In their articles, they call me a failed Congressional candidate, but they never mentioned that I moved a very blue district in Northern Virginia, which includes Loudoun County, by 13%. Joe Biden won by 19% in this district and I lost by less than 6%. Do you know who else was a failed Congressional candidate but won his U.S. Senate seat? Barack Obama (not that I want his name on the same line as mine). My opponent Tim Kaine is scared. He sees that I am very close to unseating him, so he has called me everything from an extremist, to white adjacent, to a NAZI! I never realized a Vietnamese refugee who fought for our country can be a Nazi, but again, they are unencumbered by facts or details. My wife and I were fully aware of the nasty lies and attacks against our good name and our family. They have even come after my employers to get them to fire me. We prayed a long time about running for office, but we knew if we didn’t step up, who would? We are answering the call. We can’t be intimidated by their leftist, Marxist strategies. I have put my life on the line on the battlefield, faced death and looked at pure evil in the eyes. These Democrats don’t scare me one bit, because I have woken up without a flag to stand under or a country to call my own. I WILL NOT ALLOW THAT TO HAPPEN TO OUR CHILDREN OR GRANDCHILDREN! Over my dead body! In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao, USN (Ret)Former Navy Special OperationsCandidate, U.S. Senate (VA) | TEXT HUNG TO 21412 Hung knows the American Dream is worth saving - because he’s lived it. | | | **PRESS RELEASE**

**Congressional candidate Marty O’Donnell joins leftist extremists in supporting biological men competing in women’s sports** _ _ _In[exclusive leaked audio](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=5b2462bf88&e=fc26432468), O’Donnell, a GOP congressional candidate for NV-3 states he will, “probably do nothing” in Congress to protect female athletes. _
April 17, 2023 Contact: [linnea@drewfornevada.com](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=72c313d468&e=fc26432468) **(Las Vegas, NV) **– In a recent appearance at a UNLV College Republicans club meeting, Marty O’Donnell, a Republican congressional candidate in Nevada’s 3rd district, indicated support for the NCAA's outrageous policies that allow men to compete in women’s sports. When asked what he would do to push back on woke ideologies that institutions such as the NCAA are implementing, including those that allow biological males to compete against women, take scholarships from females, and share locker rooms with girls, O’Donnell replied, “ _probably nothing_.” The question was asked after a conversation regarding the recent rule change by the NAIA that banned transgender women—or female gender-identifying individuals who were assigned male sex at birth—from competing in its collegiate women's sports. O’Donnell recently entered the Republican primary for Nevada's 3rd congressional district against leading candidate Drew Johnson, a conservative columnist, leading government watchdog, free market policy analyst, and small business owner. Johnson has been endorsed by Riley Gaines, a renowned activist for female sports. _“We need more bold, conservative leaders in Congress who aren't afraid to fight the far-left's attempts to hijack women's sports and undo the accomplishments of females in athletics. Drew Johnson has made it very clear that he'll fight the woke mob and be a leader in protecting the interests of female athletes everywhere. I stand with Drew because he stands with us_.” – **Riley Gaines** _ _ “ _Recent court decisions show that further federal legislation is needed to keep men out of women’s sports. I will support legislation to define, for federal law purposes, a woman as being a human being without a Y chromosome._ _I will fight the far-left's attempts to hijack women's sports and undo the accomplishments of females in athletics. I will stand up to the Department of Education’s attempt to change Title IX and stand with the women who have fought for decades to achieve fairness in sports_._”_ – **Drew Johnson** _ _ Johnson's campaign is managed by Linnea Saltz, a NCAA DI conference champion runner who became a leading advocate for the rights of women and girls to compete in sports fairly and safely after being forced to race against a biological male athlete. Gaines recently recognized Saltz as a pioneer in the fight to protect women's sports. To learn more about Drew or to support his campaign, visit drewfornevada.com.
###

Some political pundits have written articles that spell doom for Republican candidates, opining that conservative candidates/causes have inundated you with too many texts and too much email to sift through in a day. While It’s true that nearly every congressional campaign in the 2024 cycle will attempt to utilize online fundraising to propel them into the House/Senate, not every email or text is created equal; and **not every email or text will deliver the entirety of your donation to the candidate you think you’re donating to.**

Bad actors and political grifters have figured out that online fundraising is a good way to make a quick buck off your generosity. **Not me. Not now, not ever.**

I know a couple of things to be true:
* We must do everything within our power to hold onto the U.S. House – the future of our country absolutely depends on it

* **Democrats are outraising Republicans 2-1 most months, sometimes it can even be as high as 3-1**

That’s why I’m reaching out today. The stakes are as high now as they were in each of the past two elections, **[yet in just one month we've seen an 84% drop in donations](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=376262bdb6064510a2d465675947ab29&_e=ruk-04wG71tWmQCt8wvMSYePNlLkpWMpUUNwZCT1YKw6Sw3eVTFsNN5A5gEgXP4hv3103a3CA0dfvm8sNGfxYaXgWIxqPmyUpAgHGvulzdyTuBhFuCEnTlt_OFRYcL2kfkZ_nzt-y1XFl6GrRYkZi3Hl_dewF7Ar9lFCWcUIQPbTocmDwy_cSCaEiqP2DTYtA1RrAz1po1FaZwYM-JxriCTnLs6HGcksW3xWneiqdYIqp1QLbzwdGb0BmukjsBONkMB0K597B3wdjo1oJRIr06zkNmwnG-WJOGcjDp-f_XYVRl7I1OGc8vHzskOOODGfwyDguwX5posQq4C6jSxQ_Nlurb3ymCYjz04pfYWRhaVsAD403goyQ9sh_gtvvj6gFBgkyEnA6nzOH9Ga1t7Xog%3D%3D)**. ---
| McGuire Endorses Jean Gannon for National Committeewoman!
---
| | |
---|---
|
"To Save America, we need a National Committeewoman who is not divisive, will lead from the front, grow our party, and fully supports Trump and pro-Trump Candidates.

Jean Gannon lives right here in the 5th Congressional district and is a fierce fighter for conservatives across the commonwealth. Talk is cheap. Trump understands, the only way we save our country is hard work. Jean isn't afraid to do the hard work on the ground, making calls, knocking doors, and more to get conservative candidates elected. I'm proud to endorse Jean Gannon to be the next Republican National Committeewoman for Virginia."

-VA State Senator John McGuire

Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia
|

body:
Running on a platform of government accountability and fiscal conservatism, Robert Burns announces his entrance into the race for Executive Council

View this email in your browser (https://us18.campaign-archive.com/?e=662ba75570&u=608f5f1c5767bda1edf1ae151&id=62c44f76d2)

Dear Friends,

I am excited to announce my candidacy for the Executive Council, to succeed the retiring Ted Gatsas in District 4! I will fully vet every judicial nominee and ensure that they will strictly interpret the US and state Constitutions. I will review every contract and lease that comes before the Executive Council to ensure that the taxpayers are getting the best deal for quality services. Fresh voices are needed in state government and I will recommend that appointees are outside of the usual insider cliques. I will serve as an advocate and champion of the taxpayers in New Hampshire. My experience in business and my lifelong devotion to helping our state will guide me in this important job. To learn more and sign up to help the campaign, please visit BurnsForNH.com (https://www.burnsfornh.com?utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=62c44f76d2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) !

About Robert Burns
https://www.burns4nh.com?utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=62c44f76d2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Robert Burns is a small businessman and lifelong resident of New Hampshire. Burns was born in Nashua, graduated from Manchester West High School, and is a graduate of Keene State College with a degree in Business Management. Currently, Burns owns and operates a growing quality control and safety company in Bedford.

Burns was first elected to serve as a Selectman in Manchester’s Ward 12, where he helped oversee the integrity of the city’s elections. Burns was then elected Hillsborough County Treasurer, defeating then-incumbent Chris Pappas. Burns won the Republican nomination for Executive Council in District 4 in 2012, and 2014

In 2015, he joined Donald Trump’s campaign for President, serving as the National Youth Coalition Chairman and was a Delegate for Trump at the 2016 Republican National Convention. Over the last two decades Burns has worked on a number of campaigns, including for the Presidential races of Mike Huckabee and Newt Gingrich.

Burns won the Republican nomination for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District in 2022.

But there's one aspect that I feel gets lost in a lot of conversations around reproductive care: **Black maternal health.** What researchers have found is too egregious to ignore. In nearly every category, Black mothers are disproportionately impacted by insufficient access to maternal care. **Studies show that Black women are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related complications as white women.** Maternal mortality rates continue to climb exponentially for Black women and women of color, and we cannot continue to turn a blind eye towards it. This is not a problem that will fix itself – it will take investment in communities of color. As a mother myself, and now, a first-time grandmother, I’ve seen personally the difficult health care experiences that Black women face all too often when pregnant. That’s why I've spent my career advocating for these issues as a proud member of the Black Maternal Health Caucus and the House Health Subcommittee. In the Senate, I'll work hard to improve maternal health for women across the board and ensure that under-resourced communities have a voice that advocates for maternal health. I'm ready to get to work, but we know this race won't be easy – that's why I need your support. [**_Will you split any amount between my campaign and Maxwell Frost?
