| | **For Immediate Release:** April 17, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**Governor Gavin Newsom Endorses Dave Min for Congress**
**IRVINE, CA** — On the heels of a commanding primary election win in California’s 47th Congressional District, Governor Gavin Newsom is throwing his full support behind Dave Min in what is shaping up to be one of the most closely watched House races of the 2024 cycle. The campaign is a top priority for national Democrats and Republicans, with Rep. Katie Porter, the outgoing incumbent who endorsed Senator Min to succeed her early last year, narrowly winning the seat by 3 points in 2022.

**"In this pivotal moment for our state and our nation, we need proven leaders who not only understand the challenges we face, but are prepared to tackle them head-on,”** said Governor Gavin Newsom.**“Dave Min is such a leader. Dave has fought tirelessly to expand economic opportunities for all Californians. His efforts to ban offshore drilling and pass smart gun safety legislation are a testament to his ability to address our environmental and public safety challenges effectively. I am proud to endorse Dave Min for Congress."**

Senator Min, representing over 80% of CA-47 in the State Senate, brings a solid track record of victories in Orange County. His 2020 win over a long-standing Republican incumbent marked him as the first Democrat to represent the region in the State Senate. In office, Senator Min has been a champion of women’s reproductive rights, gun safety, and climate justice in the California Legislature, and he has also been a stalwart leader on public safety and education issues, earning the endorsements of Orange County’s Police Officers, Deputy Sheriffs, Firefighters, and Teachers.

A former University of California Irvine Law Professor, Min has dedicated his career to public service, aiming to safeguard the American Dream. After graduating from Harvard Law School amidst the Enron and Worldcom accounting scandals, Min chose the path of public service over lucrative corporate law positions, instead joining the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to prosecute corporate fraud. His journey continued as an economic policy director on Capitol Hill, where he advocated for economic fairness and opportunity during the peak of the mortgage crisis, eventually returning to California to teach at the nascent law school at UC Irvine.

Senator Min is set to face off against Republican Scott Baugh, a career politician who has been a lobbyist and perennial Congressional candidate for the past 25 years, losing in 2018 and 2022. The differences between Min and Baugh could not be starker. While Scott Baugh began his career as a corrupt State Assemblymember, engaging in campaign finance fraud, perjury, and obstruction of justice, which led to his being indicted for 22 criminal charges (including 4 felony counts), Dave Min began his career cracking down on corporate fraud and corruption as an SEC prosecutor. While Baugh has embraced whackjob conspiracy theories associated with white nationalism, stating that “wokeness” was a more dangerous threat to America’s security than 9/11 or World War II, Min has repeatedly celebrated diversity and stood up against hate in Orange County. And while Baugh has made clear that he would support a total abortion ban, without exceptions, even in the case of rape, incest, or danger to a woman’s life, Min has earned a 100% rating from Planned Parenthood and authored eight leading domestic violence bills into law. ###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country.

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ea062b3b97ac44f388df8e4a8bb3877f&_e=d3-3f9q9F0XowHRMex17Zjx3OK2tJamKOMxryqxn0qVWM66grIbnw04gEldBSk1aGwx1UnaaX0Jchp-Pxku0HA-8Y6A6OfUROrpxnU2dMzLqNey2B7zjr8SpC6G7nbmUEFRHpELEbAHnOvej5V0Y3LuP0c1K8BsP6eDHqVFI5h8XlRpoL32YgxXOhGAE3KardMRjFldlfJbdp4IZ1VsRGH5CP9vdpqri7SkYC-WIQnTRTEJbzmea5j7KaKH1W5CW3WSazxxLc3GnPDMyTHOGApldynFVEHzr8g84bfcYaaGBKAleWXuqLZdP61a7p7BMz7CcC0weDGC2ZEtP1nwg8OaCGPzZwo8yERwEkFCtgxUTy-9kWHNmSvOd4ELzt5SCQsm5XBP1s6dxQGvjGKupOg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

body:
The right-wing media wants to control the narrative around Trump’s trial. We can’t let them get away with it.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83210479/467648922/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDdjYTk1N2YtZTRmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1uCIrm8fyeni8MmqyL9YlzxJHEyL9IqbMu3_6j9ss-I=&emci=cf9b7279-e4fc-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=07ca957f-e4fc-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=14016711)

Peter,
Trump’s New York hush money trial began this week, and with it, the right-wing media circus amped up their defense of Trump.
While Trump’s lawyers defend him in the courtroom, Fox News and other right-wing media outlets are rushing to defend him on TV and online. In one of the more ridiculous examples of this kind of coverage, **Fox News anchor Harris Faulkner praised Trump for “respecting the court” just hours after Trump used the courthouse steps for an impromptu press conference where he called his case “an assault on America” and falsely claimed that he was the victim of political persecution. **
[**Americans rely on the news to learn what’s happening in the first-time criminal prosecution of a United States president – COURIER exists to make sure that news is honest. If you already support our mission, can you chip in $10 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83210481/467648923/-593472309?refcode=20240417-EM-TrumpTrial&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDdjYTk1N2YtZTRmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1uCIrm8fyeni8MmqyL9YlzxJHEyL9IqbMu3_6j9ss-I=)
Trump’s control over the right-wing media was central to making him President the first time around.
Prosecutors in this trial have already mentioned Trump’s 2016 meeting with _The National Enquirer_ executive, who promised to shower Trump with positive stories while planting negative stories about his opponents.
**But this time, with Trump being the first President to face criminal charges, it’s different.** You see, Peter, the public isn’t allowed inside the courtroom in New York. There’s no video or audio of the trial—even still photographs are limited.
**That means unbiased, honest media coverage is more important than ever. And lies and misinformation can spread unabated.**
Fox News and other right-wing media outlets spread Trump talking points for views, money, and political clout.
But at COURIER, we will never sacrifice our values or our belief in democracy just to make a quick buck. Our mission is to provide honest, unbiased coverage of the issues that matter most in the communities that need it most.

In one of the more ridiculous examples of this kind of coverage, Fox News anchor Harris Faulkner praised Trump for “respecting the court” just hours after Trump used the courthouse steps for an impromptu press conference where he called his case “an assault on America” and falsely claimed that he was the victim of political persecution. = Trump’s control over the right-wing media was central to making him President the first time around. Under Trump’s watch, we lost three million jobs, the federal deficit exploded, and working families were hung out to dry.
_Now, he wants to double down if he wins reelection. We must stop him._
**While I wake up every morning thinking about how to make life better for working and middle-class families, Donald Trump wakes up every morning thinking about how to gain more power and control for himself and his billionaire friends.**
I believe in building an economy from the middle out and the bottom up. Trump believes in trickle-down economics, which has failed America and the middle class time and time again.
I believe in protecting Social Security and Medicare, whose benefits folks have earned and rightfully depend on. Trump wants to slash these programs to fund massive tax cuts for the wealthy.
I believe that billionaires and large corporations should finally pay their fair share. Trump doesn’t. It’s as simple as that.
Under my administration, we’ve made record investments in infrastructure, health care, education, and so much more. We’ve created 15 million jobs, cut the federal deficit by over $1 trillion, and increased the corporate tax minimum.
**But, Peter, our work isn’t done yet. Think of how much more transformational change we can make to benefit _all_ Americans with another four years in the White House.**

clean_body: My view of the economy is a view from Scranton. Donald Trump’s is a view from Mar-a-Lago. | | | Peter, yesterday I gave a speech in Scranton sharing the difference between my vision for the economy -- for our country -- and Donald Trump’s. Scranton is home. It’s a place that climbs into your heart and never leaves. It’s the place where I learned that money doesn’t determine your worth and that everyone deserves a fair shot. That’s why when I look at the economy, I see it through the eyes of Scranton. Whereas, Donald Trump sees it from Mar-a-Lago. For more than 40 years, Republicans like Trump have promised that the best way to grow the economy is from the top down. Give more tax cuts to those at the top and the benefits will trickle down to everyone else. Here’s the part that they won’t say out loud : It doesn’t work like that. When billionaires and large corporations get massive tax cuts, it puts the middle class further out of reach for everyday Americans. It rips dignity, pride, and hope out of communities across this country. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | When Trump was president, he passed a $2 trillion tax cut that overwhelmingly benefited the very wealthy and big corporations. In 2020, 55 of the largest companies in America made $40 billion -- and paid ZERO in federal income taxes. Under Trump’s watch, we lost three million jobs, the federal deficit exploded, and working families were hung out to dry. Now, he wants to double down if he wins reelection. We must stop him. While I wake up every morning thinking about how to make life better for working and middle-class families, Donald Trump wakes up every morning thinking about how to gain more power and control for himself and his billionaire friends. I believe in building an economy from the middle out and the bottom up. Trump believes in trickle-down economics, which has failed America and the middle class time and time again. I believe in protecting Social Security and Medicare, whose benefits folks have earned and rightfully depend on. Trump wants to slash these programs to fund massive tax cuts for the wealthy. I believe that billionaires and large corporations should finally pay their fair share. Trump doesn’t. It’s as simple as that. Under my administration, we’ve made record investments in infrastructure, health care, education, and so much more. We’ve created 15 million jobs, cut the federal deficit by over $1 trillion, and increased the corporate tax minimum. But, Peter, our work isn’t done yet. Think of how much more transformational change we can make to benefit all Americans with another four years in the White House. Thank you, Joe Joe Biden President of the United States

body:
The Supreme Court has consistently sided with the powerful over the vulnerable.
#
On Monday, the U.S. Supreme Court revived an Idaho state law banning life-saving, gender-affirming medical care for trans youth.
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240417?refcode=em20240417-1-73&amount=5&refcode2=73_21716_umcBWF&akid=73%2E21716%2EumcBWF)

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

subject: Peter, I have always fought for the right to choose

body:
With your help, I can continue the fight in Congress... Peter --The recent threats to reproductive rights are alarming, and it's clear that we need strong advocates in Congress to protect the right to choose. **[That's why I'm reaching out to you today.](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail20.com/t/d-l-ejrskt-djqxtuyu-r/)** When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, they endangered the fundamental right of every woman to shape her own destiny. But as your congressman, I will stand up against those who seek to undermine the right to choose and will fiercely defend it.[**Let's be clear --I'm the only candidate in this race who has stared down the GOP and emerged victorious in defending reproductive freedom.**](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail20.com/t/d-l-ejrskt-djqxtuyu-y/)In North Dakota, I single-handedly defeated a bill that aimed to muzzle pro-choice voices on college campuses. And in South Carolina, I led a successful campaign to help thwart a draconian measure that would have criminalized vital information about abortion access.**[But our fight is far from over.](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail20.com/t/d-l-ejrskt-djqxtuyu-j/)** We need to rally together and secure the votes needed to enshrine reproductive rights into law. **[Your contribution, no matter the size, will fuel our campaign and drive us closer to victory.](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail20.com/t/d-l-ejrskt-djqxtuyu-t/)** Join me in the fight to defend reproductive freedom. Together, we can make a difference! [Donate Now](https://joecohnforcongress.cmail20.com/t/d-l-ejrskt-djqxtuyu-i/) In solidarity,
Joe Cohn

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
Hi Friend, it’s Senator Brad Pfaff, representing District 32.
Now that session is over and my reelection campaign is officially underway, my team and I will be putting in the work to run another successful people–powered campaign.
To achieve that, we’ll be traveling a lot over the next few weeks to spread our pro–working family message and collect nomination signatures.
Friend, as you can probably guess, getting our message out is very expensive, and people–powered campaigns like ours rely on donations from folks like you. Will you chip in any amount to help us afford essential supplies like fliers and yard signs, as well as training and travel for our dedicated volunteers? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240417_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
My #1 priority over the next few weeks will be to meet as many District 32 residents as I can – especially because the district lines changed.
I’ve always loved this phase of campaigning because I can connect with residents where they are. And when they tell me about the issues and concerns on their minds, it helps me determine what I need to focus on in the coming months.

Peter, It’s been just over a year since _ProPublica_ released a bombshell report exposing that Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas and his wife accepted extravagant vacations — worth up to $500,000 — completely on the dime of prominent GOP mega-donor Harlan Crow. It was just one of _several_ examples of the flagrant disregard for transparency and ethics on the Supreme Court. That’s why, over the last year, I’ve taken several steps to advance accountability, transparency, and fairness on the Supreme Court and our federal judiciary:
* I introduced the _Stop Judge Shopping Act_ to stop far-right, anti-abortion extremists from gaming the federal courts in our favor

* I called on the Supreme Court to immediately implement a Code of Ethics for justices with robust accountability measures — and for Congress to mandate a Code of Ethics for the Supreme Court if they fail to act

* I co-sponsored the _Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal and Transparency Act_ to increase transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, including by allowing members of the public to file ethics complaints against sitting justices

The American people’s trust in the Supreme Court remains at an all-time low, and that’s why I will continue fighting to ensure everyone can get a fair shake before it. Peter,

I’m reaching out to you today because I’m running for Congress in Nevada’s 3rd District, **but I’m not what you might expect...**

You see, I’m not a lawyer, a politician, a bureaucrat, or even a big-time CEO.

_**I’m a composer.**_

_I created the soundtracks for a couple of large video game franchises you might have heard of – Halo and Destiny._

I know I’m the last person you might expect to run for office. But the truth is, I care too much about this country, and I can’t continue to stand by and let it head in the direction it’s going without jumping into the fight to save it.

Shortly after I launched my campaign last month, I was surprised and honored to receive this notification from **Elon Musk.**

body:
evanlowforcongress.com [evanlowforcongress.com]
Hi friend, it’s Evan here.
I want to make something very clear: I did not call for the recount, nor did anyone from my team. Any claims that this recount is on behalf of my campaign are false.
If you can, please rush a donation to my campaign so we have the resources needed to defend ourselves in this costly recount process. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evanlowuplift?refcode=X_041724_notourrecount_actrs]
If you don’t know what I’m talking about, let me catch you up to speed: After a rollercoaster ride of a campaign, the voters of California’s 16th District made their voices heard. Our campaign ended up tied in second place, meaning both me and the candidate I tied with would advance to the general election. That was until a former staffer and donor of Sam Liccardo called for a recount.
It’s a politically motivated move and it’s going to cost our campaign hundreds of thousands of dollars. A situation like this is nearly unprecedented and something we could not have anticipated. Now, we have just a few short days to raise the funds it’ll take to defend our campaign in two separate counties’ recount efforts.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you, friend. Our campaign didn’t call for this recount, but we still have to foot the legal bill. Can you chip in a few bucks to help us get through this process? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evanlowuplift?refcode=X_041724_notourrecount_actrs]

I’m confident that after we get through this recount, we’ll be on our way to the November ballot - but we can only do it with your help.
Thank you,
Evan Low

body:
No one is going to harm my family.

| [](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dd667d4342b54f44bad3ec40030d9bc2&_e=KofsmMhSRz2J5Daoh4yD9tRy1tjoRIWWzadqxvT8Te4OqtcN7nsnIxWAexfvUga_WY5acPtu0L8Yowc8cdtUL8m7iNHBpEE_bANZGXtE76zc_zmwNIINqNvgWVtKLtJrno7hWL_e_XFVQQftEDbTCkQC4GaZt2DqgZZwDE-XZDxJmD8P2qn_4-ch9iQDYSKlf5rocUUZmY5FPym58oei5Ah4zXg28UYy2JDB9zxQF52r2qNYQdJmaOt-RaXMp5WOrlz4A3Aycjxl4ho6lPZU6W4fRhoj0WwUN91LEAIaF4NeknotUP8T-TRBdCmMiyCFvSwEHI18-VFF_hUP_KuADQ%3D%3D)

**THERE IS ZERO NEGOTIATION OVER THE SECOND AMENDMENT.**
Fellow American, I'm a gun owner, and I can promise you no one is going to harm my wife and children. ****

****LET 'S TAKE A SECOND AND TAKE A LOOK AT THE FACTS:

**6% OF ALL GUN HOMICIDES ARE AT THE HANDS OF AN AR-15

60% OF ALL GUN HOMICIDES ARE AT THE HANDS OF A HANDGUN

****** **The Left, who defunded the police, opened our border, and created a national migrant crisis, is dead set on diminishing our 2A rights.**

| [**PROTECT MY 2A**](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dd667d4342b54f44bad3ec40030d9bc2&_e=KofsmMhSRz2J5Daoh4yD9tRy1tjoRIWWzadqxvT8Te4OqtcN7nsnIxWAexfvUga_WY5acPtu0L8Yowc8cdtUL8m7iNHBpEE_bANZGXtE76zc_zmwNIINqNvgWVtKLtJrtF5-E3mAcpV28ZJe4IRKVekDHhZjDvJ6jjKQrPxbZXhQSO_xnOvKhFuJ1q9uDD62vxKe7mLQN3e3GUCVhUFzagmnWGaNNN419vVMmrvSYCYYxiftVYxkPqcHloLhsOVdveOvvUE0TbKW3BmZmz0G5dCy-MSsWH5nguq_PWeiGA4gSR364YvnYwy91cjZecfs6z9qlOt5DzSiMhQXi2Fw7g%3D%3D)
---

The Left tries to tell you that civilian-made AR-15s are weapons of war. As a veteran, I've seen weapons of war, and I would not take a civilian-made AR-15 into battle. The Left is happy to blame AR-15s, but **I blame the homicidal maniac.**

[**PROTECT OUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS**](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dd667d4342b54f44bad3ec40030d9bc2&_e=KofsmMhSRz2J5Daoh4yD9tRy1tjoRIWWzadqxvT8Te4OqtcN7nsnIxWAexfvUga_WY5acPtu0L8Yowc8cdtUL8m7iNHBpEE_bANZGXtE76zc_zmwNIINqNvgWVtKLtJrtF5-E3mAcpV28ZJe4IRKVekDHhZjDvJ6jjKQrPxbZXixwEIxtes8Fq7p0ctlOPWF-1880o1vyvvi7mN4aH589UL_AxtQ7f7PvJblwN8hPXUipgRv2smqmRV87XjTeJjmZKfGl35fj6I9e_cBQ5f7vb-9J28Ivo4RKzaa35BGjzxfjuwsvIvn7qpHR6NH0WaglL9c-s753-jeXqujxq0kUQ%3D%3D)
---

To walk into the Capitol daily, I have to walk through metal detectors. I walk by brave men and women who carry weapons every single day. **Serving in Congress does NOT make me more important than my children.**

[**PROTECT OUR FAMILIES**](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dd667d4342b54f44bad3ec40030d9bc2&_e=KofsmMhSRz2J5Daoh4yD9tRy1tjoRIWWzadqxvT8Te4OqtcN7nsnIxWAexfvUga_WY5acPtu0L8Yowc8cdtUL8m7iNHBpEE_bANZGXtE76zc_zmwNIINqNvgWVtKLtJrtF5-E3mAcpV28ZJe4IRKVekDHhZjDvJ6jjKQrPxbZXjgzvgEFOFqFCt-Du0IODdylKbhZ9cB8TB19USwPG6ziZ4m91hsnSR3aD2pTDJfqUlCZmOUTXIjQ2tZYn-J3umQai0rvUtIWNZ61iA_EqqXsXNb3ECVBe1hU2PF1MJX1oI1YLJVCKADkCCsDF9fWpZpt9IzmaguavdmmqEqLdJqww%3D%3D)
---

**So, instead of eroding our Second Amendment rights, let 's protect our children. Our children should have the same protections that we have in Congress. **
More than 400 million guns are in circulation around the country.**The overwhelming majority of gun owners are law-abiding citizens.**

**I refuse to allow our Second Amendment rights to be further eroded by disarming our population, making our country less safe, and bringing us closer to communism. Because that 's how it happens: you disarm your population, and then the government takes control. **

**[We cannot allow this to happen. This fundamental right to bear arms has never been more critical.](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=dd667d4342b54f44bad3ec40030d9bc2&_e=KofsmMhSRz2J5Daoh4yD9tRy1tjoRIWWzadqxvT8Te4OqtcN7nsnIxWAexfvUga_WY5acPtu0L8Yowc8cdtUL8m7iNHBpEE_bANZGXtE76zc_zmwNIINqNvgWVtKLtJrjnCw3VkciukNq9iO4wwIGyCk0PyOGnotu-x7S7BNCqgUZjgtM9sIdotVmBk1hMuqsSLqSIfv-b2YBtZ9aiyZjx-r3UYpdRxuq8KM6Obq6s-Q7z99pETGSZ9dkQoOr52e284XYqKLCCrhUhAEkYHlP1OITihvNX5GjN8RlrBTPqc9a7aKwcctBEmpeNzNW_vh)**

_Wesley_

name: Stephanie Mohr
subject: Emergency pardon petition
body:
On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets.

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I'm asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=74bde51443ba4d0e998a3327493eaa56&_e=Ho6P61YGvOVOZoTgN2w3o79lMp8edb9lPPB18Dx0q61gdoKVgvI5dI_7zd9iRaiBAmNvl06qT7gG-bdeKdQJhya9Z5HJTISnnQBiTjx6mjhKkNPwuKeFne6rUOPjs1mkBp0bLMP6VY_1N0cgygaQR0On2cAC1iEoJeNEXTy7Zf6eI4QSu7tfMXsc9rU6sChaxKvbefBLQ4AZm8z0gYcnEEjOBDhwpw1MSoCyi1omiOXebgtVSWZxU5E1MOv5lHUeakLoJ7B-NMtpo37bzyUFz1ti_QUlsFisfRrjf86IvOWdjVMJuRi6PMaLXbn2fr_h1dMx9yoCddV95oMrA2-8alCr1ZluQUMKS1VXQoGdVho8e-9Du_DC3aTPDObAX1cU)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I'm asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=74bde51443ba4d0e998a3327493eaa56&_e=Ho6P61YGvOVOZoTgN2w3o79lMp8edb9lPPB18Dx0q61gdoKVgvI5dI_7zd9iRaiBAmNvl06qT7gG-bdeKdQJhya9Z5HJTISnnQBiTjx6mjhKkNPwuKeFne6rUOPjs1mkBp0bLMP6VY_1N0cgygaQR0On2cAC1iEoJeNEXTy7Zf6eI4QSu7tfMXsc9rU6sChaxKvbefBLQ4AZm8z0gYcnEEmqw4lz994pGFRkti-S_CGYF56afqp3D8isB1pZZifAs28Axdi4Z0gSxWND8WJaGkM7tm3hfWMJWzeFUMOh7XXStife1dwOxNV43vMNDWFAXSWYFYh44lEqEz7XU7QakZjSOVAlluy7padh0Eqa_lCVdqPteoFi_g2Zu2YiJz4y)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials - in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me - I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones - not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense - but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. clean_body: On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I'm asking you to sign this because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won! A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom. My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials - in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me - I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones - not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense - but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That's why I can't turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. And I hope you won 't either. Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! clean_body: We need to recruit, train, and mentor the next generation of political changemakers in Vermont. | | Peter, I’m excited to announce that after a successful inaugural summer last year, the Balint Organizing Corps (BOC) program will take place again this year to recruit, train, and mentor the next generation of political changemakers in Vermont! BOC is a paid opportunity for Vermont high school and college-age young people to learn about grassroots organizing, political changemaking, and electoral campaign work. This eight-week program will take place from Monday, June 17, 2024 - Friday, August 16, 2024, and requires a commitment of 10-15 hours per week. In 2022, Congresswoman Becca Balint became the first woman and first LGBTQ person to represent Vermont in Congress. The Balint campaign set out to change politics: From the ground up, with courage and kindness. Our organizers had thousands of conversations with Vermonters, recruited hundreds of volunteers, and organized in every county in the state. We built a community of people dedicated to Vermont and built grassroots power that enabled a queer middle school teacher to become Vermont’s first congresswoman. But big cultural change doesn't happen with just one campaign or one election cycle. We need to keep showing up and do the work every year, in every community. We need new decision-makers at the table, and that starts with the folks who work on campaigns. BOC trains the next generation of organizers so that we can elect the next generation of leadership in Vermont. Our Climate Workshop is a professional development program that empowers young people to receive real hands-on experience in the climate space.
Here’s what we’ll be focusing on:
* Helping you find job opportunities in the climate sector
* Advocating for climate action
* Teaching you everything you need to know about the climate crisis

Now more than ever, young people are instrumental in driving climate action. We have the power to save our planet, but we need your help. As the next Governor of New Hampshire, I will fight tirelessly to ensure that all women have the right to reproductive freedom.

**Quite simply I've spent my life working to alleviate human suffering.** It's my life's work, it's my passion and it's that mindset I want to bring to Congress. **This is who I am and this is what I've done:** 1) Helped to end genocides, mass atrocities and human trafficking 2) Assisted families who lost loved one's after the terrorist attack on 9/11 3) Provided aid to asylum seekers and immigrants along the southern border 4) Helped children with life-threatening illnesses 5) Given comfort and aid to families impacted by the mass shooting in El Paso 6) Provided shelter and comfort to those impacted by Hurricanes Katrina and Harvey 7) Delivered humanitarian assistance to communities in the Dominican Republic and Cuba. **It's time we sent a different kind of person to the House of Representatives. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83219374/467680302/28553127?refcode2=1a697208-f8fc-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&noskip=true&refcode=em240417&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTY5NzIwOC1mOGZjLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_cWBPYhsYZUrdPqvCefPmFUxOV-xwNnw-pv8VhvQvyY=)

* He just recently said he wants immigrants from “nice countries” like Norway.

* And let’s not forget his constant attempts at Muslim bans.

As an immigrant myself, this rhetoric disgusts me. Trump has repeatedly used his sickening view of the world to spread hatred and extremism throughout the country. And as his presidential campaign heats up, his threat against our democracy does too.
Extremists like Trump don’t understand America and our diversity, and if given the opportunity they will create extreme border policies that will hurt migrants — no matter if those migrants are fleeing from dangerous living conditions or seeking refuge.
We cannot afford to let MAGA extremists dictate immigration policy in America.

subject: Del. Sewell's April 17th Newsletter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Briana Sewell
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
April 17th Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
Did you see the eclipse last week? What a spectacular sight! The next celestial viewing isn’t until 2044, and I hope to experience it as well. This week, I’m sharing with you some community updates, events, and resources as well as sharing some updates post veto deadline which passed on April 8th, and highlights of important education legislation which was passed during the General Assembly session that may affect you or your kids come next school year. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/IMG_0970.jpg]
Deadline For Vetoes Passes and The General Assembly Reconvenes
The governor had until April 8th, 2024 to sign, veto, or amend all legislation passed by the General Assembly during the 2024 legislative session. With that deadline now passed, the Governor has reviewed all 1,046 bills passed by the General Assembly and communicated to him by the clerks of each of the respective bodies.
Of the 1,046 bills sent to him, the governor signed 777 bills into law (74%), proposed amendments to 116 measures (11%) and vetoed a record 153 pieces of legislation (15%). You can see the comprehensive list of all bills which the governor signed here [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+APP] , vetoed here [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+VET] , and amended here [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+REC] . All vetoed and amended bills will be returned to the General Assembly for the reconvened session on April 17th, 2024. The General Assembly may override vetoes with a 2/3rd vote and accept or reject amendments which will then be returned to the governor.
Issue of the Week: K-12 Education (Part 1)
In an effort to share with you legislation which passed in 2024 that may affect your lives without inundating you with all 1000+ pieces of legislation at once, I have added a new series to the newsletter where I highlight interesting bills which passed the General Assembly during the 2024 legislative session.
To kick off this series I want to highlight the bills which passed through the House K-12 Education Subcommittee and ultimately passed the General Assembly. I’ve divided the K-12 bills into parts and will address health and safety, out of school time and extra curricular activities, and at-risk youth, special education and English Language Learners. Stay tuned for more education legislative updates in the coming weeks! Many of these bills were signed into law by Governor Youngkin, some have been vetoed, and a few have been amended by the Governor.
Health & Safety
Many of the bills sent to the governor’s desk focus on the health and safety of students in public schools. Several bills related to reversing overdoses and stocking medicine in schools were signed by the governor in early April. My HB732 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb732] (which was identical to Sen. Pillion and Pekarsky’s SB726) was signed by the governor and will go into effect on July 1st. This law will require schools to stock and train staff on the use of at least two unexpired doses of Naloxone, a life-saving overdose reversal drug, as well as encouraging students to complete an opioid overdose prevention and reversal program of instruction prior to graduating from high school.
SB498 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb498] (which was amended by the Governor) requires the Board of Education to establish guidelines for schools to respond to and notify parents about school-connected overdoses. Delegate Bennett-Parker’s HB1039 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb1039] allows schools to stock undesignated glucagon which may be used to reverse an emergency blood sugar low in a diabetic student and was signed into law on April 4th.
Additionally, both HB66 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb66] which required schools to conduct fire drills in accordance with statewide fire code (instead of at predefined intervals), and HB561 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb561] which included specific technology systems in the list of items to be reviewed and evaluated in required annual school safety audits were signed into law by the governor. HB498/SB225 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb498] which requires each local school board to notify parents annually of their legal responsibility to safely store firearms around children was amended by the governor.
Out of School Time and Extra Curriculars
Two bills surrounding out of school time and extra-curricular activities passed the General Assembly this session were both signed into law. HB 98 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb98] which allows schools to accept participation in the Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps as fulfillment of any high school PE requirements. SB707 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb707] explicitly permits public middle school and high school to establish career and technical education student organizations, regardless of whether such school offers career and technical education courses.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-04-17%20at%204.10.57%20PM.png] This bill came from students in Senator Subramanyam’s district who were told they couldn’t start a middle school HOSA - Future Health Professionals club because the law wouldn’t allow it for middle school students!
If you want to view some awesome student civic engagement, I suggest you watch the middle schoolers’ testimony here [https://virginiageneralassembly.gov/house/chamber/chamberstream.php] . Their speeches start at 8:42 am. This is also an opportunity to remind you that if like these students, there are any issues in the community that you are passionate about solving through legislation, please do not hesitate to reach out and we will problem solve with you to see if we might be able to introduce a bill in the future regarding your issue.
At-Risk Youth, Special Ed, English Language Learners
Homeless youth, foster youth, and students involved in the juvenile justice system face many barriers which put them at risk of dropping out of school or not having fundamental needs met. The three bills below sought to bridge gaps in support and build resources for supporting these students were signed into law. HB168 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb168] directs the Virginia Department of Education to develop a list of supports and services to homeless students. SB433 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb433] directs the Board of Education to adopt policies relating to supporting students with limited and/or interrupted formal education in the completion of high school. Alongside these bills, HB1477 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb1477] sought to support students at-risk of dropping out of high school by allowing schools flexibility in offering alternative school arrangements for students who may need a different schedule because a standard 8pm-3pm school day does not work for them.
This year several bills sought to support English language learners (ELL), which make up more than 10% of Virginia’s students and who need additional support to succeed in school. HB624 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb624] (amended), SB105 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=SB105] (amended), and HB1247 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=hb1247] (signed into law) restructure teacher to students ratios for English language learners and rewrite funding formulas so that students who have the highest needs for English language support (those who have recently immigrated to the country or have low English literacy and fluency) get the the most intensive small group support while students who are farther along on their language learning journey will be in classes with teacher to student ratios closer to non-ELL classes.
Two bills this session which sought to improve the quality of education in Virginia for students with disabilities were signed into law. SB60 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb60] requires the Department of Education to create guidelines for IEP teams to ensure age-appropriate and developmentally appropriate instruction for students with special needs. SB220 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb220] and HB1089 which improves special education services for families by improving data and reporting through Virginia IEP, ensuring schools have special education parent/family liaisons, and increasing ease of access to IEP information for parents and families.
Stay tuned next week for part 2 of the education bills that passed the general assembly this year, and if there is another legislative topic area that you are particularly interested in learning about, let me know and I’ll pull that topic to the top of the list for future legislative issues of the week.
State & Local News
Virginia lawmakers have voted to raise the marriage age to 18. Most states haven't [https://www.vpm.org/npr-news/2024-04-04/virginia-lawmakers-have-voted-to-raise-the-marriage-age-to-18-most-states-havent#] | NPR-VPM
Brigitte Combs wipes away tears after speaking to Virginia lawmakers in favor of a bill to raise the minimum age of marriage. She was married at 15 years old to a much older man — later fleeing.
Va.’s public education accountability system overhaul [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/04/08/va-s-education-accountability-system-advances-carries-possible-risks-for-low-performing-schools/] | Virginia Mercury
New system slated to improve transparency, carries possible risks for low-performing schools. The Virginia Board of Education is proposing that kind of transformative change for its new accountability framework, by splitting up the state’s accreditation system into two parts.

Hi Peter,
You know what else we are in the middle of? A tough primary campaign in an incredibly high-stakes election.
Donald Trump and Kari Lake will be on the ballot again.
After the Arizona Supreme Court’s devastating ruling bringing back an 1864 abortion ban, Arizonans' access to safe and legal abortions is truly in jeopardy.

| Peter,

As the weather warms and the trees start to bloom, I’ve been enjoying my time in my garden at home in the Lehigh Valley. As a young adult, I developed a love of organic gardening, and to this day, it is my favorite hobby.

Gardening brings me more than just the fruits of my harvest; it has taught me the power of patience, perseverance, and passion. I bring this same spirit to my work in Congress, where I've dedicated myself to serving the people of the Lehigh Valley with the same care and dedication that I pour into my garden. In Congress, just like in the garden, success often requires collaboration and cooperation. That's why I've made it my mission to work across the aisle, bridging divides and finding common ground to get things done for our community. **Whether it's advocating for better healthcare, championing environmental protections, or fighting for economic opportunities, I believe that progress is possible when we come together.**

But let me tell you, the work isn't always easy. Just like tending to a garden, it requires hard work, patience, and a willingness to weather the storms that come our way. Yet, just as we see the fruits of our labor blossom in the garden, so too do we see the impact of our efforts in Congress—improving the lives of our neighbors, strengthening our community, and leaving a lasting legacy for generations to come.

Every dollar we invest in our public schools is an investment in our future.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83220372/467683340/-735451230?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-04-17_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjM2ZjNjNzEtZmFmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=A2O6gWGQKFizjpg1Y5m4O7V8AEdUm8_VQ7kmC6_2jKo=)

| Peter,

As a mom of three school-aged children here in Virginia – one in elementary school, one in middle school, and one in high school, and as a proud product of Virginia public schools, I know that our public education system is one of the most important tools we have to build the next generation of leaders.

We must provide our public schools with the resources they need to flourish — including paying teachers and staff what they deserve. We need to recognize the invaluable contributions of our educators and make sure they have the tools necessary to guide our children toward success. Additionally, we cannot afford to overlook the significance of strengthening our workforce training programs and supporting Virginia's terrific higher education institutions.

I am committed to championing these causes as your next Governor. Together, we will tackle the teacher shortages, address learning loss, and recognize the value of investing in our public schools.**Every dollar we invest in our public schools is an investment in our future.**

**As the next Governor of Virginia, I will work tirelessly to make sure our schools are the best in the country.[_Your contribution to my campaign today will propel us closer to our shared vision of a brighter, more prosperous future for all Virginians._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83220373/467683341/-735451230?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-04-17_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjM2ZjNjNzEtZmFmYy1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=A2O6gWGQKFizjpg1Y5m4O7V8AEdUm8_VQ7kmC6_2jKo=)**

| [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=6097bee588&e=c0babbc643) **Meet local author Kevin F. Adler in Atherton next Tuesday at 6:30 PM. I'll be there to learn more about him and his book, When We Walk By.**

Think about the last time that you saw or interacted with an unhoused person. What did you do? What did you say? Did you offer money or a smile, or did you avert your gaze?

_When We Walk By_ takes an urgent look at homelessness in America, showing us what we lose—in ourselves and as a society—when we choose to walk past and ignore our neighbors in shelters, insecure housing, or on the streets. And it shows what we stand to gain when we embrace our humanity and move toward evidence-based people-first, community-driven solutions, offering social analysis, economic and political histories, and the real stories of our unhoused neighbors.

**“Death to America!”**

It’s the kind of chant you’d expect to hear from the Ayatollahs of Iran or in an ISIS training camp.

_But right here in Michigan, “activists” are calling for the complete destruction of the greatest country on Earth - all while benefitting from all the freedoms America has to offer._

These people don’t want “peace.” They want a Marxist theocracy. It’s DISGUSTING.

Most of these people have spent their whole lives living under the freedoms America has to offer. They’re free to practice their faith as they want. They’re free to criticize our government if they choose to. They can vote without fear of violence, and they have the same chance at the American Dream as you and I.

**They’ve never ACTUALLY seen the horrors of terrorism. But I have.**

My name is CAPT Hung Cao. I served in the Middle East and Africa as a U.S. Navy Captain. I saw the most dangerous corners of the world. _**And trust me when I tell you: if America falls, there is nowhere else to go.**_

**I won’t let the country I put my life on the line for, fall to the same people I spent my career fighting. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate, and I need your help.**

The Democrat party cannot be trusted with our country anymore. They’ve caved to the furthest Left radicals who don’t want freedom or democracy. They remain silent as their supporters openly chant “Death to America!”

I’m not ashamed to say that I LOVE America! My family fled communism in Vietnam to come here. And trust me when I say - I will never let our country go down the same path as the one we were forced to leave.

**When I’m in the Senate, I will make sure America-hating terrorists get the treatment they deserve**. I’ll secure our border - where people on the terrorist watchlist are flooding in - and make sure everyone coming into our country is here because they followed the law and want to truly be an American.

Wadeafter 49 years of protection. Here's what "leaving it up to the states" really means: Arizona's Supreme Court just upheld a law from 1864 that almost completely criminalizes abortion. 1864. This law was written when black women were still enslaved and subject to forcible rape. This law was written before any woman had the right to vote. Does this law make sense in 2024? This is about the fundamental right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness that we will lose if someone as cruel and careless as Donald Trump wins a second term in the White House. So, how do we keep him out of the Oval Office and his signature off of a national abortion ban? We run up the Democratic vote totals in rural areas of targeted battleground states and relegate him to Florida's golf courses for the rest of his life. = When we increase the Democratic vote share with on-the-ground work by good local candidates and fiery local activists knocking on doors and having real conversations with fellow rural voters, Republicans are losing a segment of voters they figured they didn't even have to try with. = = We're thrilled to support our rural candidates and volunteers and honored to have you alongside us! | | One thing is for sure, Peter: **The once mighty NRA is on its last legs.**

What once appeared to be an unstoppable force in American politics, the NRA has seen a mass exodus of over one million members, corruption charges, and millions of dollars in legal fees — meanwhile their overall revenue dropped 52% since 2016.

A former top NRA official told The New York Times: “The NRA is little more than a shell of itself.”

I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—but I also know that the gun lobby is scrambling to keep their influence in Congress by pouring money into the NRA’s replacements.

When I see these headlines, Peter, I know our work is far from done. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83224377/467696607/-2074411583?refcode=20240417.2_DH_4AE&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2Q3MjQyNS0wNmZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T-EXuPHV-V337fW-iIm2jqThYhJW93yQ3Yyr9ICHmro=) With or without the NRA, as long as there are corrupt, purchased politicians in Congress, the gun lobby will buy their votes and strike down any chance we have for common sense gun reform.

But, if we elect a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action, we can stop the scourge of gun violence in America and block the gun lobby’s agenda.

Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders to state legislatures across the country, and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning from now to Election Day.

[_**So if you want to make an impactful difference in this year’s election, can you split a $20 contribution between Leaders We Deserve and GA Dems today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83224378/467696608/-2074411583?refcode=20240417.2_DH_4AE&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2Q3MjQyNS0wNmZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T-EXuPHV-V337fW-iIm2jqThYhJW93yQ3Yyr9ICHmro=)

Folks,

I’m more nervous than a cat in a room full of rocking chairs.

I reached out the other day about how I won’t be able to hold down the front lines much longer without the resources and support from strong conservatives like yourself.

---
Peter,

There’s a reason I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs: My vote is not for sale.

In my time in Congress, I found what’s most challenging is money in politics. The truth is that it costs money to run for office, and it affects the kind of people who can step up and run for office.

In the last three elections, I’ve run against three straight self-funding candidates who have spent a lot of their own money to try and win this seat. Thanks to the strength of our movement, we’ve won against three Republicans who thought they could buy a seat in Congress. We’ve shown again and again that New Jersey isn’t for sale.

**What we’ve always had is a powerful grassroots movement fueled by people like you, Peter. This time is no different.**

But Republicans are getting ready to pour millions of dollars into New Jersey, and they’ll throw even more in if Bob Menendez runs as an Independent and makes this a 3-way competitive race.

Now more than ever, New Jersey needs hard working, trustworthy leaders focused on the common good and injecting some integrity and civility back into our politics.**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and that’s why we’re confident in our campaign.**

body:
My senior Senator and friend Bob Casey is running for re-election!!!
#
Hey Derek, it’s John. I really need to talk to you about my friend Bob Casey.
The 2024 election is here — and **the GOP’s road to winning back the Senate runs right through PA.**
Republicans are zeroing in on 2024’s battleground states as we speak. You can bet Mitch McConnell and the GOP’s shadiest billionaires will spend hundreds of million$ to attack Bob.
This is *seriously* scary stuff, but you know what gives ME hope? This amazing grassroots team!!!
The way we stopped the GOP in 2022 is the same way we fight back and re-elect Bob now: by bringing together an ✨all-star grassroots team✨ that can stand up to the GOP’s money by folks chipping in $5, $25, or more at a time.
Together, we’ll defend PA’s Senate seat, as long as we don’t lose sight of the stakes. **Holding this seat is make-or-break for our Democratic majority.**
[**With that in mind...please, Derek, split $5 or more between Bob’s campaign and mine. We need to build a winning campaign between now and Election Day, so I’m asking for yinz guys to dig deep!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240417-1?refcode=em20240417-1&amount=5&refcode2=8929_434096_K5yg0y&akid=8929%2E434096%2EK5yg0y)

We won in 2022, and we’ll do it again this year if we give this race our all. And I’ll be there every step of the way, just like Bob was for me when I was taking on the GOP.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

The Texas power grid is at it again, Peter.
**Texas’s power grid operator, ERCOT, announced this week that the grid is on high alert as temperatures across the state and demand for electricity soars.**
Unfortunately, this is the new norm in Texas thanks to our broken power grid.
Three years ago, millions of Texans were left to freeze in the dark during a winter storm that shut down the Texas power grid. But since then, state leaders like Greg Abbott haven’t taken action to fix the grid for good.
That’s why I introduced the Connect The Grid Act — to connect Texas’s power grid to the nation’s supply and boost reliability and sustainability of our state’s electric supply.
[**I want to tell you more about this important bill in a second, but first, can you chip in $5 or $10 to help us power the Connect the Grid Act? ---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
April 17th, 2024
Contact: Duane Dichiara
Phone: (916) 997-4784
---
| **Peace Officers Research Association of California Endorses Congressman John Duarte **
---
| | **Modesto, CA** — Congressman John Duarte announced that his reelection campaign is endorsed by the Peace Officers Research Association of California (PORAC). PORAC is a public safety association representing over 80,000 officers in uniform, making it the largest public safety association in California. PORAC joins the growing coalition of local Democrats, Republicans, and nonpartisan organizations backing Duarte.

In response to the endorsement, Duarte said: “Every day in Washington, I work alongside Democrats and Republicans to keep our families safe by giving our local law enforcement the support they need. I am grateful that PORAC and its members have endorsed our campaign, and I look forward to continuing my work with PORAC to make our Valley safer.”

John Duarte’s commitment to law enforcement and public safety is not just empty rhetoric. name: Madeleine Foote, LCV
subject: QUICK SIGNATURE NEEDED: This is big -- climate funding for farmers is in danger
body:
Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding a judiciary that works for people and our planet.

Tell Congress to Rein in the Supreme Court

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in two key cases that threaten the EPA's and other agencies' ability to protect the people from big business.

Congress must stop MAGA judges' right-wing power grab. Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress rein in the Supreme Court and urgently prioritize confirming pro-environment, pro-democracy judges. https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.

Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections.

In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts.

In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power.

Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/RZbkcvK_

These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more.

Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come.

Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench.

Your support fuels local climate victories.

Today, I want to do something a bit different. I want you to truly understand why and how our team decides which candidates we endorse, and where we decide to allocate our resources. **Jane PAC’s strategy is straightforward: We use every tool available to us (in compliance with federal, state, and local campaign finance rules) to support climate champions in crucial races across the country where important climate policy hangs in the balance.** **In addition to direct financial support and leveraging our platform to amplify their campaigns, we help recruit volunteers, provide advice on policy, communications, media relations, and other key campaign needs.** Instead of focusing on volume by endorsing as many candidates as possible, we decided to adopt a focused approach — endorsing fewer candidates in targeted races to maximize our impact in the races we _do_ get involved in. Additionally, you may have noticed that we focus a great deal of our energy on down-ballot races. While many political organizations invest in the high-profile federal races, the resources we bring to the table for state and local candidates go much further, and our influence on climate policy can be more immediate. It’s not just about stretching our resources though. While the federal government can (and should) pass impactful climate legislation, state and local governments have significant power to implement policies that shape our everyday lives. These races might fly under the radar, but their influence on land use, public transportation adoption, and local sustainability policy is profound. Take, for instance, the situation in Chicago with General Iron — a metal-shredding business that was moved from a predominantly white, affluent neighborhood to a primarily low-income community of color in Southeast Chicago after the local government caved to complaints from their wealthier constituents. This relocation not only spotlighted environmental racism but underscored the crucial role local elections play in environmental justice. That dynamic totally shifted when Jane PAC helped elect Brandon Johnson as Chicago’s new mayor. Instead of perpetuating systems of injustice, Mayor Johnson not only kept up the fight against the General Iron relocation, he also initiated a _groundbreaking_ lawsuit against major fossil fuel corporations for their decades of deception and damage they’ve wrought on vulnerable communities, and our planet. And friends, we’re ready to replicate that success during this year’s elections. One of our major priorities this year is to challenge “Oily Democrats” in the California Legislature and ensure that seats where incumbents are termed out are filled with climate champions, not fossil fuel company allies. We are focusing on several legislative seats essential to this fight. **[You can learn more about each of them and lend your support to their campaigns here!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83228008/467709679/1328794144?home&refcode=ea.676674b2-13fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.676674b2-13fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY3NjY3NGIyLTEzZmQtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yATeohzvcrI83kqTyfV3gHFO4TWcQ-9iYHXLjO770hc=&emci=6e908bfe-ecfc-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=676674b2-13fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=4823105#endorsements)** But we’re not just focusing on California. We are identifying key battles nationwide, supporting climate champions in states where the balance of the legislature is particularly vulnerable. We even seek candidates for little-talked-about offices like comptroller and county supervisor, where the outcome can significantly affect our climate fight. In 2023 alone, our efforts led to significant victories across the country, from helping Democrats secure majorities in both chambers in Virginia’s state legislature to pivotal local elections in Denver, San Antonio, and Pittsburgh. This year, we’re focused on races like the Salt River Project in Arizona, where we helped elect three climate champions to the SRP Board, and the upcoming election for Port of Brownsville commissioners, where we’re contributing thousands of dollars to protect South Texans from dangerous fossil fuel infrastructure expansion. Moreover, we’ve endorsed over a dozen climate champions in California, Texas, Pennsylvania, Oregon, and Arizona (with more to come). I’m committed to these fights because I know how much they matter. I’ll continue to keep you updated on Jane PAC’s efforts and how you can get involved this year, so stay tuned. Thank you for taking the time to read this. | | Fellow Patriot,

You might know my husband Hung from his U.S. Senate campaign, and you might even have seen me out and about in our Commonwealth by his side!

But today, I want to take a moment to introduce myself personally, after all you've done for our family and our mission.

My name is April Cao, and besides being Hung's wife I'm an EMT, writer, and mother of five.

You see, my husband owes his life to this country. He and his family escaped communism in Vietnam. If it wasn't for the generosity of America, he might not be here today.

But he wasn't satisfied with just settling down in our country and fading into the background. For 25 years, he put his life on the line for America as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer.

_And now, even though his military career is over, he 's not done fighting for our country - and that's why he's running for U.S. Senate. _

**Hung isn 't a career politician like Joe Biden and Tim Kaine. He's a true American fighter, and he would do ANYTHING to help make our country stronger. **

**[Today, I'm reaching out to ask you to stand with my husband as he embarks on this incredible journey.
